portal_hypertension.title: Short-term mortality is reduced and low grade ACLF reversed by TIPS in patients with fluid overload: a case-control study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Cervantes-Alvarez E, Gu W, Byrtus J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 1324）。核心观点：门脉高压是失代偿性肝硬化及其并发症的特征。 临床提示：它可能引发慢性肝衰竭（ACLF），死亡率很高。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension characterizes decompensated cirrhosis and its complications. It may trigger acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF) which carries a high mortality. Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) is the most efficient therapy for most portal hypertension-related complications including fluid overload (FO) defined as refractory or recurrent ascites, hepatorenal syndrome and/or hydrothorax. However, TIPS for FO in ACLF is questioned. In this case-control study, patients from the prospective cohorts CANONIC (n= 1324) and German TIPS-Registry (n= 724) were screened for cases of FO and matched 1:1 by sex, age, MELD and presence and grade of ACLF. portal_hypertension.title: Alcohol-Related Liver Disease: A Review.
portal_hypertension.authors: Krag A, Åberg F, Mellinger J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：酒精相关性肝病（ALD）是肝脏相关发病率和死亡率的主要原因，也是欧洲和美国肝移植最常见的适应症。 临床提示：在美国，ALD 相关死亡率从 1999 年的每 10 万人 6.7 人死亡增加到 2022 年每 10 万人 12.5 人死亡。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) is the leading cause of liver-related morbidity and mortality, and the most common indication for liver transplant in Europe and the US. In the US, ALD-related mortality increased from 6.7 deaths per 100 000 people in 1999 to 12.5 deaths per 100 000 people in 2022. ALD can develop with long-term daily alcohol consumption of more than 20 g per day for women (1.4 standard drinks/d) and more than 30 g per day for men (2.1 standard drinks/d), with 1 standard drink containing 14 g of ethanol, equivalent to approximately 12 oz of beer, 5 oz of wine, or 1.5 oz of distilled spirits.
